title: Solar System VR
desc: Stand on a glowing platform in the middle of the solar system. Point your controller at a planet to learn about it, and turn around, because Saturn passes right behind you.
features: All eight planets orbiting the Sun, plus the Moon, an asteroid belt and a passing comet
Point at a planet and pull the trigger to open an info panel
Planets grow slightly when you aim at them, with bigger hit areas so small ones are easy to pick
Runs in the browser, in a VR headset or on desktop
